svg.title: Head to head on the same tasks
svg.desc: On the same tasks, who wins? Over all runs: both pass 360, only haiku ts-off 133, only haiku ts-on 93, both fail 214.

g.text: Head to head on the same tasks
Every shared task falls in one of four boxes. In the middle: tasks only one side passed, A's wins to the left of the
centre line, B's to the right. Tinted ends: tasks both passed (left) or both failed (right). Lengths are shares of each
